'''Odynosian''' is a religious tradition associated with [[Imperial Suomi]] in the old source material.

The extracted Suomi source lists Odynosian as the country's religion but does not describe its theology, institutions, clergy, calendar, or relationship to the [[House of Jarvinen]]. This draft preserves the name as a canon anchor only.

== Open Canon ==

Before publication, Odynosian needs a dedicated religion pass. The safest current handling is to treat it as a source-attested Suomi religious identity without inventing doctrine.
